info.title: Zoho Inventory Universal API
info.description: Manage inventory catalog, contacts, sales orders, packages, shipments, and invoices

put.description: Marks a sales order as confirmed in Zoho Inventory.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

salesOrderId.description: The Zoho Inventory salesorder_id for the sales order.

organizationId.description: Zoho Inventory organization ID to run this request against.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.description: Creates a new contact in Zoho Inventory.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

organizationId.description: Zoho Inventory organization ID to run this request against.

contactName.description: The display name for the contact.

contactType.description: Whether the contact is a customer or vendor.

companyName.description: Company name for a business contact.

contactPersons[].description: One or more contact people associated with this contact.

contactPersons[].firstName.description: First name of the contact person.

contactPersons[].lastName.description: Last name of the contact person.

contactPersons[].email.description: Email address for the contact person.

contactPersons[].phone.description: Phone number for the contact person.

contactPersons[].isPrimaryContact.description: Whether this is the primary contact person.

post.description: Creates a new invoice in Zoho Inventory.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

organizationId.description: Zoho Inventory organization ID to run this request against.

customerId.description: Customer to bill on the invoice.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number when auto numbering is disabled.

send.description: Whether to send the invoice after creation.

dueDate.description: Invoice due date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

referenceNumber.description: External reference number for the invoice.

lineItems[].description: One or more invoice line items.

lineItems[].itemId.description: Item to add on this invoice line.

lineItems[].quantity.description: Quantity to invoice for this line.

lineItems[].rate.description: Rate for this invoice line item.
